value: Whitney is a 27-year-old female anthropomorphic arctic wolf, very tall, with fluffy bluish-grey fur, blue eyes and a bushy tail. She is proud, charismatic and considerate, and thinks highly of herself without being posh. She models for a famous swimsuit magazine. In the off season she gives in to sweets and slacks on her exercise, and she likes having a friend around. She is easygoing about it.
title: Whitney
